So ushers get a door sheet, and it has what theaters to go to in an order so you can clean each theater after everyone gets out efficiently. I told my manager that last part was false but I didn’t see an issue with telling them as it saved them time. My manager told the couple we were sorry and he gave them a free movie pass.
